The gym · Vineland, NJ

Inside South Jersey's best-equipped gym

Specialty equipment, real recovery, a women's-only training space and a cafe and supplement store under one roof at Cumberland Mall.

Book a free tour See memberships
The equipment

Machines lifters ask for by name

Most gyms in South Jersey run one brand of selectorized machines. Animal Paradise runs Arsenal, Atlantis, Rogue, Booty Builder and StarTrac side by side, so every muscle group has more than one way to train it.

  • Plate-loaded and selectorized machine floors
  • Full free-weight area with dumbbells and racks
  • Booty Builder glute stations
  • StarTrac cardio line
  • Posing room for competitors
On the wall

Home of the biggest dumbbells in the world

It's painted on our wall for a reason. Come see them in person.

Cardio

A full cardio floor

Treadmills, bikes and more, lined up under the lights and open 4AM to midnight.

80FT

Of functional training turf

The turf

Room to push, pull and sprint

An 80-foot lane of turf for sled pushes, farmer carries, lunges, sprints and conditioning. It is the part of training a treadmill can't do, and it is open every hour the gym is.

Recovery and wellness

Recovery is where results happen.

The training breaks you down. These put you back together.

Take a look

Massage chairs, compression and sauna rooms

The Hibernation Station is our recovery room: a row of full-body massage chairs and Sharper Image compression therapy boots. Next door, the sauna rooms are open to every member.

  • Full-body massage chairs
  • Compression therapy
  • Sauna rooms, included with every plan
  • Fit3D body scanning
